title: rules_sync.mjs --check: a required refusal with no control; its --self-test rewrites the drift and exits 0
claim: rules_sync.mjs --check (governance.yml policy-docs, inside the required gate) has no positive control: nothing in the tree drives it against a drifted rule, and the control D11.M1 names for an instrument, `--self-test`, on a tree with one drifted .mdc exits 0 having rewritten that file.
mechanism: rules_sync.mjs treats every argument but --check as regenerate mode, so `--self-test` silently regenerates (writes) the generated rules and reports success. field_coverage.mjs records it as 'none' (byte compare, no field) and no acceptance, mutant arm or self-test step drives the refusal; emptying `process.exit(drift ? 1 : 0)` would leave every control green.

evidence.unit: control_red_on_drift (1 = the --self-test control goes red on a drifted tree)
evidence.contention_note: temp copies only; exit statuses and file bytes, contention-immune

perturbation.change: `const check = process.argv.includes('--check') || process.argv.includes('--self-test')` (harness --perturb, on the temp copy)

metric_definition: Whether `node tools/policy/rules_sync.mjs --self-test` exits non-zero on a copy whose .cursor/rules/brief-citations.mdc has one appended line (1) or exits 0 (0).
phenomenon_property: Every refusal a required job runs has a positive control that goes red when the refusal is emptied, and an instrument asked for a control it does not have refuses the flag rather than running its production (writing) mode.

null_control.value: in-sync copy: --check rc=0, --self-test wrote 0 files; drifted copy: --check rc=1
null_control.note: the refusal itself is alive (check_refuses_drift=1); only its control is missing

reproduction_steps: run the harness: --check on drift rc=1; --self-test on drift rc=0 and 'RULES-SYNC: 1 file(s) written'
proposed_fix_scope: Give rules_sync.mjs a --self-test that builds a temp tree, drifts and orphans one generated rule, and asserts --check refuses both and passes the in-sync tree; refuse unknown flags; add the step to governance.yml instrument-self-tests (selftest_scope ids).
